description: This file is an initialization module for the azure image generation configuration components within the litellm project. It imports configuration classes, defines exports, and provides a function to select the appropriate image generation configuration based on a model string.

classes.name: BaseImageGenerationConfig
classes.description: Base class for image generation configuration, imported from transformation module.

classes.name: AzureDallE2ImageGenerationConfig
classes.description: Azure-specific configuration for DALL·E 2 image generation.

classes.name: AzureDallE3ImageGenerationConfig
classes.description: Azure-specific configuration for DALL·E 3 image generation.

classes.name: AzureGPTImageGenerationConfig
classes.description: Azure-specific configuration for GPT-based image generation.

methods.name: BaseImageGenerationConfig get_azure_image_generation_config(model: str)
methods.description: Function that returns the appropriate image generation configuration object based on a model string.
